title: implement an LRU cache
prompt: Implement LruCache in src/lru.ts. `get(key)` returns the value (or undefined) and marks the key most recently used. `set(key, value)` inserts or updates and, when the cache would exceed its capacity, evicts the least recently used entry. `size` reports the number of entries. Constructing with a capacity below 1 throws a RangeError. Keep the file valid for Node's type stripping (no enums or parameter properties).
